body: Is the naming of that function here alright? That was a question I asked myself.

It's not clear to me what it means, but I also don't understand why you had to add this.
You seem to have missed the existing `get_export_option_visibility` API (see the Android export plugin).

It's two separate things. I do currently use `get_export_option_visibility()` in the PR.

`get_export_option_visibility()` is there to flag which option is visible or not. I do use that function in order to hide "non-enabled" options.

Both Apple exports and Android use a thread in order to check if plugins have changed in order to set a flag to update or not. But there's not actually a "callback" of when an option is actually checked or not. `export_option_set` is a new function that gets called when an option is actually edited. It has in parameter the edited property path.

If the edited property is a "toggle" property (like enabling or not threads), it sets a boolean that flags the properties as dirty. So when `should_update_export_options()` gets called, it will return `true` and the options gets updated.

Without that callback, clicking on "threads enabled" just does nothing, as the options never gets invalidated.

> `get_export_option_visibility()` is there to flag which option is visible or not. I do use that function in order to hide "non-enabled" options.
> 
> Both Apple exports and Android use a thread in order to check if plugins have changed in order to set a flag to update or not. But there's not actually a "callback" of when an option is actually checked or not.

Hm. We've used `_get_export_option_visibility()` to make options appear or disappear in response to changes to other options in a number of cases without needing this. What makes this property different?

I have a feeling you could remove the `export_option_set()` thing and this would still work. If I have chance later I'll do some testing

Heh, ok, so I did some testing, and it doesn't work if the `export_option_set()` is removed - but it definitely used to!

I tested Godot 4.4.1 (by checking/unchecking the "Use Gradle Build" option on an Android export), and it doesn't work there either. But if I try on Godot 4.3, it _does_ work!

So, it seems we broke this sometime between Godot 4.3 and 4.4.1. I'll see if I can track down what did it

**UPDATE 1:** I've narrowed it down even further - it looks like it broke between 4.4-dev6 and 4.4-dev7

**UPDATE 2:** As I re-remember how this system is supposed to work, it's the [`update_visibility` property](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/591e70ff78c665ff11e1f21998d0e52fbc3f23c8/editor/export/editor_export_platform.h#L219) on `ExportOption` that's supposed to mark an option as being something that would cause visibility to be updated

**UPDATE 3:** Ok, nevermind, we didn't break it! It was just that we changed the custom templates to be dependent on both "Use Gradle Build" _and_ "Advanced Options" in PR https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/93867, so my testing was flawed.

Sorry for being all over the place on my previous comment :-) but I've solved the mystery!

This change is all you need to make to this PR to allow the visibility to update without the `export_option_set()` thing:

```patch
--- a/platform/web/export/export_plugin.cpp
+++ b/platform/web/export/export_plugin.cpp
@@ -361,7 +361,7 @@ void EditorExportPlatformWeb::get_export_options(List<ExportOption> *r_options)
        r_options->push_back(ExportOption(PropertyInfo(Variant::STRING, "custom_template/release", PROPERTY_HINT_GLOBAL_FILE, "*.zip"), ""));
 
        r_options->push_back(ExportOption(PropertyInfo(Variant::BOOL, "variant/extensions_support"), false)); // GDExtension support.
-       r_options->push_back(ExportOption(PropertyInfo(Variant::BOOL, "variant/thread_support"), false)); // Thread support (i.e. run with or without COEP/COOP headers).
+       r_options->push_back(ExportOption(PropertyInfo(Variant::BOOL, "variant/thread_support"), false, true)); // Thread support (i.e. run with or without COEP/COOP headers).
 
        r_options->push_back(ExportOption(PropertyInfo(Variant::BOOL, "vram_texture_compression/for_desktop"), true)); // S3TC
        r_options->push_back(ExportOption(PropertyInfo(Variant::BOOL, "vram_texture_compression/for_mobile"), false)); // ETC or ETC2, depending on renderer
```

It sets the [`update_visibility` property](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/591e70ff78c665ff11e1f21998d0e52fbc3f23c8/editor/export/editor_export_platform.h#L219) on `ExportOption`

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/61e95035-cd1b-42eb-9666-8b27d03fe292

For clarity: Desired enhancement is already in effect for Android preset and seems to be working as expected without `export_option_set()`
